### REVOLVE Opens New Store at Aventura Mall, Expanding Its Physical Retail Presence


October 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s203.q4cdn.com/458606031/files/doc_news/REVOLVE-Opens-New-Store-at-Aventura-Mall-Expanding-Its-Physical-Retail-Presence-2026.pdf)


**The Greater Miami location marks the brand's third permanent store, bringing the REVOLVE experience to one of the country's most premier retail destinations.**


MIAMI


, Oct. 23, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- **REVOLVE** , the next-generation fashion retailer, today announced the opening of its newest and first Florida permanent retail location at **Aventura Mall** , located just north of Miami. The 4,512-square-foot store, officially opened to the public on September 29, marks the next step in **REVOLVE's** strategic retail expansion, bringing the brand's curated shopping experience to one of the nation's leading luxury shopping destinations. The new store builds on the success of the brand's flagship location at **The Grove in Los Angeles** and its boutique store in **Aspen** , further extending **REVOLVE's** omnichannel presence.


Designed as a destination with its own identity, the **Aventura Mall** store features a thoughtfully curated assortment tailored to the Miami customer, reflecting the region's year-round warm climate, vibrant nightlife, and active lifestyle. From effortless daytime dressing to elevated occasionwear, the assortment will evolve throughout the year with curated edits tied to Miami's signature cultural and lifestyle events. Featured brands include **REVOLVE's** leading owned labels, such as **REVOLVE Los Angeles** , **Camila Coelho Collection** , **Eaves** , **SRG,** and **L'Academie** , alongside top third-party designers from **REVOLVE** and **FWRD** . The store will also offer dedicated **REVOLVE Man** and **REVOLVE Beauty** assortments, bringing the brand's full lifestyle offering to the Miami customer.


To celebrate the opening, **REVOLVE** will partner with **Li-Ning** and **Way of Wade** to host a special in-store event with **Dwyane Wade** , newly appointed **Chief Performance Officer of REVOLVE Man and FWRD Man** , on **Sunday, October 25, from 1PM to 3PM** . Open to the public, the event will feature music from a live DJ and a curated selection of **Way of Wade** footwear and apparel, including the **WoW 12** performance basketball shoe in the Miami-inspired Vice Marble colorway, a **REVOLVE-exclusive** Wade County lifestyle sneaker, and the first **Way of Wade x REVOLVE** apparel capsule. Customers who purchase **Way of Wade** product will also have the exclusive opportunity to meet **Wade** in person.


"Miami has long been one of our strongest markets, with a highly engaged customer base and community that we've connected with through activations over the years," said **Michael Mente, Co-Founder and Co-CEO of REVOLVE** . "Opening at Aventura Mall is a natural next step in our retail expansion strategy, allowing us to meet our customers where they are and deepen those relationships beyond e-commerce. While every REVOLVE store shares our signature DNA of curated fashion, elevated design and discovery, each location is thoughtfully tailored to its market. Aventura brings that vision to life through a distinct lens, creating a destination for customers to discover exclusive products, engage with the brand and connect with our community."


**REVOLVE's** physical stores extend the company's digital-first platform into a retail environment, translating its signature merchandising and brand aesthetic into an engaging in-person experience. Thoughtfully curated product assortments and intuitive store design encourage discovery while seamlessly extending the **REVOLVE** brand.


**REVOLVE Store at Aventura Mall** **Hours:** Monday – Saturday: 10:00 AM – 9:30 PM; Sunday: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM


**Location:** 19565 Biscayne Blvd., Suite 1982, Aventura, FL 33180


**Media Contact:**revolveus@karlaotto.com


**About REVOLVE Group, Inc.** Revolve Group, Inc. (NYSE: RVLV) is the next-generation fashion retailer for Millennial and Generation Z consumers. As a trusted premium lifestyle brand and a go-to online source for discovery and inspiration, REVOLVE delivers an engaging customer experience from a vast, yet curated, offering of apparel, footwear, accessories, and beauty styles. A dynamic platform connects a deeply engaged community of millions of consumers, thousands of global fashion influencers, and more than 1,600 emerging, established, and owned brands.
